subject: REPLACE statement
notes: kb/Work PB1358 (w68x): 'A REPLACE statement may be specified anywhere in source text or in library text that a character-string or a separator ... may appear' (cite.py OK 7.2.4.3 1)). REPLACE is located by the same text-word walk that finds COPY (FindStatementKeyword, which replaced FindKeywordAtLineStart and FindCopyKeyword), never inside a literal, a directive line or a longer word. Probe midline.cob was COBOL0001 near '=', now START / AAA; golden leg [B-C] is a REPLACE inside a DISPLAY statement.
